title: Text and icons take role tokens that pass contrast in both themes
context: Teal primary icons and coral error text fell below AA on dark cards.
decision: A new `--error-text` colours error text and icons on card and accent surfaces: in light mode it is the error fill, in dark mode brand coral (6.04:1 on the dark card). A new `--primary-text` colours teal text and icons; in light mode it equals primary, in dark mode it is a lighter teal that passes on dark surfaces.

alternatives.option: Lighten or darken the single tokens in place
alternatives.reason: One value cannot pass on both the light card and the dark card; the fill and the text need separate roles.

consequences: Components choose between the error fill and error-text by role.
